propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) import adapters.jira at various nesting depths, violating the backend port abstraction required by epic bbf1 AC3.

The Backend Protocol must expose scalar, read-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) without vendor-shape parameterization to enable core modules to decouple from Jira adapter internals.
The fetcher's fail-closed behavior for unset projects and applier's DIG-defaulted cross-project guard must be preserved through new protocol members that delegate to resolve_jira_settings.
Environment readiness validation (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) must be moved from _attestation.py to a neutral BackendEnvError exception raised by assert_env_ready().
A neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError exception must be defined in the backend port so apply_handlers can catch it generically while preserving soft-fail semantics for assignee mismatches.
All four vendor-import sites must be verified absent from fetcher.py, applier.py, apply_handlers.py, and _attestation.py using a full-tree AST walker (ast.walk) rather than top-level-only inspection.
